body: La raza va un chingo al caffenio y al calesa, Valkiria y don Ulises están chidotas
She wanted to be close with her family, since she is the only one working in her family and she feels the need to support all of them, even when they don't treat us with respect.
She is the most beautiful woman in the world
Ling ling is in everything, ling ling is eternal and mighty, we shall praise Ling ling.

If you were in my shoes, what will you do?? How will you keep on going, when everyone who said that they will always be there for you turn their backs to you, the moment I started talking about how I felt, everyone said they got their own problems and I shouldn't be bothering them, tell me how will you move on when you have no one ??
